# Hunt result: the forgotten app is "10x" (not "iMake")

## Best-candidate identification

**Name:** `10x` — GitHub org/repo `10x-app-builder/10x` (github.com/10x-app-builder/10x.git)

**What it is:** "An AI-powered iOS app builder for macOS. Describe the app you want, and 10x generates production-quality SwiftUI code, scaffolds an Xcode project, and previews it on the iOS Simulator — all from a conversational interface." (verbatim from its README). Native macOS SwiftUI app (`10x-macos.xcodeproj`, entry `TenXAppApp.swift`) running a full client-side Claude agentic tool loop: NL prompt → plan mode → build mode → ToolExecutor writes Swift files → XcodeGen (bundled binary in `10x-macos/Resources/xcodegen`) → `xcodebuild` + `simctl` → screenshot back into the UI. Supabase auth, Claude via thin API proxy, projects persisted to `~/Library/Developer/TenXApp/{project}/`.

**Where it lives (archived, retrievable):**
- Archive: `/Volumes/External Storage/ARCHIVE/2026-09-01_work.tar.zst` (209 MB compressed / 272 MB raw), path inside: `work/personal/10x/` (~300 files excluding .git)
- Manifest: `/Volumes/External Storage/ARCHIVE/2026-09-01_work.manifest.md`
- Original path before archiving: `~/4-Archive/work/personal/10x`
- Branch `main`, 1 local branch, **last commit 2026-04-19**

**State when frozen:** Working MVP — ROADMAP.md says "Core loop works end-to-end" (describe → plan → build → simulator preview). It had a full release pipeline for the builder itself: notarized DMG + Sparkle updater + Vercel download site, CI workflows (release-beta/stable/channel.yml), release notes for 1.0.0-beta.7 → 1.0.3. TestFlight was on the roadmap but NOT built: "One-click TestFlight upload", "App Store metadata generation", "Code signing management" sit under Distribution → **Later**. License: PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0. Repo notes say "This is a private repo."

**Evidence for the Cursor memory:** `ideas.md` is a competitive analysis of Bolt.new, v0, Lovable, **Cursor**, Replit Agent, Create.xyz, and the positioning line is literally: "Cursor for app building — a native, professional-grade tool that gives developers control over the AI." That plus the autonomy-slider-from-Cursor idea is almost certainly where the "built around Cursor" memory comes from. The "iMake" name doesn't exist anywhere on disk (zero hits across all 28 manifests, both tar listings, and $HOME depth-3 find).

**Live TestFlight tooling still on the machine** (separate from 10x but proves the ambition went live):
- `~/.asc/` — App Store Connect CLI config, created 2026-05-01, last touched 2026-08-20. config.json keys (names only): key_id, issuer_id, private_key_path, default_key_name ("Macbook-claude-1"), app_id (empty), vendor_number (empty), timeouts/retries. A web session cache exists under `~/.asc/web/`.
- `~/.appstoreconnect/private_keys/` — one AuthKey_*.p8 API key (created ~2026-05-01).

## How to retrieve 10x

```sh
mkdir -p ~/restored
zstd -d "/Volumes/External Storage/ARCHIVE/2026-09-01_work.tar.zst" --stdout | tar -xf - -C ~/restored/ "work/personal/10x"
```
Or check whether github.com/10x-app-builder/10x is still accessible (it was the `main` remote; archived copy has 1 local branch so the remote likely matches). I already extracted README.md, ROADMAP.md, ideas.md to the session scratchpad: `/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-aryateja/5938522e-4a71-4d68-b7b0-92a13d159520/scratchpad/work/personal/10x/`.

1. **Personal-Software-Factory** — `/Volumes/External Storage/ARCHIVE/2026-09-01_Personal-Software-Factory.tar.zst` (177 MB / 597 MB raw, from `~/4-Archive/Personal-Software-Factory`). This is the "always-on software factory" *generalized* (not iOS): top-level FACTORY.md, MASTER-PLAN.md, progress.md, Plans/psf-integration-plan.md, engine/ (harness-cli, spine), domains/ (all 4 businesses + nl2shell.com), docs/ (~20 planning docs incl. CURRENT-STATE.md, decisions.md, overnight-agents). Inside it: `factory/` = **aryateja2106/factory.git** (branch backup/2026-08-12, last commit 2026-08-13) — a disler-style ADW pipeline (adws/adw_plan.py, adw_build.py, adw_scout.py, adw_simple_sdlc.py, gates.py, agent_cc.py/agent_pi.py; scout/planner/documenter/reviewer session logs; specs/, requests/, app_docs/; has a `.env` — do not print). Also disler's super-simple-software-factory (branch fix/unwired-gates-must-fail) and inkwell-agent-sandboxes-and-software-factory, plus a `glaze-system-instructions/` copy. No TestFlight/xcodebuild/iOS content anywhere in the tar listing.

## Glaze package summary — `/Users/aryateja/Downloads/glaze-system-instructions 2` (0.625 MB, ~160k tokens incl. the concatenation)

Verbatim extraction of every system prompt/skill/rule powering the **Glaze macOS app builder** (a Claude-driven Electron-style builder: React/Tailwind renderer + Node main process + WKWebView, JSON-RPC 2.0 IPC). - **README.md** (8.8K): 8-agent runtime — Main Orchestrator routes work; Context Gatherer reads project memory; Frontend/Backend Architects implement; Compliance Checker validates against skill checklists after every sub-agent; Error Investigator patches runtime errors from logs; SDK Upgrade agent; Issue Report agent. guides/CLAUDE.md injected into every agent's context; skills loaded just-in-time.
- **ALL-SYSTEM-INSTRUCTIONS.md** (283.8K, ~71k tokens): single-file concat. Structure: Index → "Combined Contents" → Section 1 Agent Prompts (orchestrator workflow: Gather Context → Plan → Architecture Decision → Execution → Validation → Update Project Context, plus a Mandatory Post-Change Rule) → Section 2 Guides (CLAUDE.md: directory structure, path aliases, protected files, Tailwind v4 only, IPC security model, WKWebView caveat, bundling rules; GLAZE-APP-GUIDE.md: AI reading guide, critical rules, decision trees "Where Should This Code Go?" / "Which IPC API Should I Use?", backend window management, handlers, performance rules) → skills → rules.
- **prompts/** 8 files, 49.8K total (~12.5k tokens): 01-main-orchestrator 12.6K, 07-upgrade 20.9K are the big two; architects/checker/investigator/gatherer/issue-report 2–3.5K each.
- **guides/**: CLAUDE.md 14.9K, GLAZE-APP-GUIDE.md 42.3K (~10.6k tokens).
- **skills/** 22 files, 166K total (~41.5k tokens): biggest are glaze-component-patterns 28.7K, glaze-native-components-migration 14.4K, glaze-browser-window-recipes 12.9K, glaze-core-imports 10.7K; the rest cover lifecycle, IPC, data storage (two-tier), drag-and-drop, file associations, native permissions, protocol/large files, window sizing, CLI deps via Homebrew, and 5 one-time SDK migrations.
- **rules/** 4 files, 6.8K: bundling (native modules/CJS), common-tasks index, debugging runtime errors, WKWebView rendering caveat.

Nothing was modified; all extractions went to the session scratchpad only. No secret values were read or printed (only key/variable names from ~/.asc/config.json; the factory/.env inside the tar was left untouched).
